description: This file defines the 'Rule' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages the configuration and validation of auto-filter rules for spreadsheet columns, including rule types, values, operators, and grouping options.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Represents an auto-filter rule for a spreadsheet column, allowing configuration of rule types, values, operators, and groupings with validation and parent linkage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Rule instance, optionally setting its parent column.

methods.name: getRuleType
methods.description: Returns the current rule type of the auto-filter rule.

methods.name: setRuleType
methods.description: Sets the rule type after validating it against allowed types.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value(s) associated with the rule.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Assigns a value or array of values to the rule, validating date grouping if array input is provided.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the current operator used in the rule.

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the rule's operator after validation against allowed operators.

methods.name: getGrouping
methods.description: Gets the grouping associated with the rule, such as date or dynamic group types.

methods.name: setGrouping
methods.description: Defines the grouping for date or dynamic filtering, validating the input.

methods.name: setRule
methods.description: Sets the rule including operator, value, and optional grouping in one call, with internal validation.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent column object associated with this rule.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Assigns a parent column to this rule.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Rule object, detaching from parent references.
